description: This file defines the Quotes class for the vtiger CRM system, implementing its database interactions, relations, and module-specific logic for handling quote entities.

classes.name: Quotes
classes.description: Represents the Quotes entity in vtiger CRM, managing database interactions, relations, and business logic specific to quote records.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves the quote record to the database, updating related inventory products and currency info.

methods.name: get_salesorder
methods.description: Retrieves sales orders related to a specific quote.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Fetches activities (tasks) associated with a quote.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Retrieves the activity history related to the quote.

methods.name: get_quotestagehistory
methods.description: Provides the change history of the quote's stages.

methods.name: get_column_value
methods.description: Overrides parent method to handle specific column value formatting.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Constructs the secondary query part for reporting on the Quotes module.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation table definitions between Quotes and other modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes relationships between a quote and other entities like Accounts, Potentials, or Contacts.
